# QukTik

> QukTik is a free, high-speed web utility designed to download TikTok and Douyin media without watermarks in pristine 1080p MP4 quality, extract 320kbps MP3 audio tracks, and save full-resolution photo carousels.

## Core Capabilities
- [TikTok Video Downloader Without Watermark](https://www.quktik.com/tiktok-video-downloader): Saves clean videos without dynamic TikTok logos, author badges, and ending bounce cards, returning clean 1080p Full HD MP4 files.
- [TikTok to MP3 Converter](https://www.quktik.com/tiktok-mp3): Formats original high-fidelity audio streams into 320kbps MP3 sound files for offline listening, sound design, and phone ringtones.
- [TikTok Photo & Carousel Downloader](https://www.quktik.com/tiktok-photo): Extracts all individual slides from TikTok image slideshows in lossless JPG format with original accompanying music.
- [TikTok Story Saver](https://www.quktik.com/tiktok-story): Archives 24-hour disappearing public TikTok stories in HD before they expire.
- [Douyin Video Downloader (抖音下载)](https://www.quktik.com/douyin-downloader): Built-in Chinese text regex parser that isolates short URLs from Chinese clipboard shares and downloads unwatermarked Douyin videos.
- [TikTok Ringtone Maker](https://www.quktik.com/tiktok-ringtone): Converts viral soundbites and dialogue into iOS (.m4r) and Android (.mp3) ringtones and alarms.
- [TikTok Avatar Downloader](https://www.quktik.com/tiktok-avatar): View and download full-size 1080p square profile pictures (PFPs).
